name: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow
description:
About This Game

In EVERGROW: SHARDS OF TOMORROW, the environment is the main character. Uncover the secrets of the lost world as you solve puzzles and unearth long forgotten story. What will you discover? Can you restore what was lost?

Key Features

  • Discover a Unique World: Explore a desolate wasteland in what begins as a search of a mysterious signal. Uncover relics of the past that reveal the story of a lost civilization.

  • Embark on an Adventure: What starts as a simple mission soon unravels into something far greater. In this linear adventure, solve puzzles to progress and uncover the truth behind the planet’s downfall.

  • A Living Environment: As you uncover the past, witness the world change before your eyes. Clear the corruption and restore Evergrow to its former glory.

About the Game

EVERGROW is a puzzle-adventure game set in a ruined world, where players solve puzzles to uncover its forgotten past. Inspired by genre-defining classics, it features a stylized aesthetic influenced by the timeless charm of older titles.

The game's main goal is to provide a visually stunning, atmospheric experience while evoking the feeling that no matter how much something is broken, it is never fully lost.

The game's core loop revolves around exploration, solving puzzles, and escaping threats, creating a cycle of discovery, challenge, and survival.
short_desc: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?
